verdict_rationale: Overall library score of 7.55 is MEDIUM-HIGH, but the presence of 1 CRITICAL component (hx-radio), 2 HIGH-tier components (hx-data-table, hx-clinical-status), and critical systemic issues (82 components lacking HelixElement base class, FormMixin adoption at 12.5%) block READY status. Library is CONDITIONAL pending resolution of Phase 4 Priority 1-4 items.

top_systemic_issues.fix: Migrate hx-dialog to extend HelixElement for consistency with the rest of the library. Even though hx-dialog is not form-associated, extending HelixElement keeps the inheritance chain uniform and future-proofs the component.

The bottom-tier fallback should reference a design token primitive or be omitted in favour of the semantic token. Evaluate whether #ffffff fallbacks throughout the codebase can be replaced by var(--hx-color-neutral-0) without the raw hex, relying on the token system being always-loaded via document-token-adoption.

Rename the `ariaLabel` property to `accessibleLabel` with attribute `accessible-label` (matching the hx-action-bar pattern), add backward-compat deprecation warning in the setter, and update the React types in HxSplitButton/types.ts accordingly.
Change `const labels: Record<string, string>` to `const labels: Record<AlertVariant, string>` so TypeScript enforces all variants are handled and the `?? ''` fallback becomes unnecessary dead code.

Audit and document the intentional `Hx*`/`Wc*` re-exports. If they exist only for backward compat, add `@deprecated` JSDoc. If they are unintentional duplicates, remove them and clean up consumer callsites. Standardize on `Helix*` class names as the public API.

Convert actionsSlot and titleSlot change tracking to use @slotchange=${this._handleActionsSlotChange} bindings in the template, then use @state() booleans. Remove the imperative addEventListener calls and the corresponding stored handler references.

top_systemic_issues.issue: as any casts in test files
top_systemic_issues.fix: Replace `as any` casts in tests with `as unknown as HxDataTable` or use a helper like `setProperty(el, 'columns', ...)` typed with `unknown`. Alternatively define a `TestHxDataTable` interface that widens the property types to `unknown` for invalid-value testing.

Systematically adopt FormMixin across all form-associated HelixElement subclasses. The mixin is already well-designed and the HelixElement base class provides the _internals accessor it relies on. Delegate implementation to lit-specialist per component.
Replace console.warn('[hx-toggle-button] ...') with devWarn('hx-toggle-button', '...') to match the library-wide pattern.

Remove role='radiogroup' from the <fieldset> element and rely on the native fieldset + legend relationship. If a non-fieldset wrapper is desired, replace with a <div role='radiogroup'> and a separate <legend>/<span> as the accessible label.

phase4_priorities.task: Migrate all 60-82 LitElement-extending components to extend HelixElement. Start with hx-dialog, hx-card, hx-alert, hx-tabs, hx-top-nav, hx-split-button as the highest-risk sampled set, then apply a codemods script to remaining presentational components.
phase4_priorities.rationale: 82 of 98 components lack HelixElement base class, blocking form lifecycle hooks and all future shared infrastructure. Highest frequency systemic defect. Codemods-scale fix for non-form components (change base import + class extends only).

phase4_priorities.task: Fix hx-radio CRITICAL: extend HelixElement, replace connectedCallback direct setAttribute calls with reactive property bindings in updated(). This is the only CRITICAL-tier component.
phase4_priorities.rationale: Score 1.0 — only CRITICAL component. Extends LitElement AND uses raw setAttribute for ARIA management, bypassing Lit's reactive system entirely. Direct patient-facing accessibility risk.

phase4_priorities.task: Complete ariaLabel→accessibleLabel migration on hx-combobox, hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-textarea, hx-steps, and hx-split-button. Update corresponding hx-react types (HxComboboxProps, HxSplitButtonProps, HxTextInputProps). Regenerate CEM after migration.
phase4_priorities.rationale: HTMLElement.ariaLabel property shadowing is a TypeScript strict violation and creates silent property override bugs. Incomplete migration creates inconsistent public API surface. Directly affects 5+ HIGH-tier components.

phase4_priorities.task: Audit all token-completeness violations: (1) Define --hx-overlay-white-{10,15,20,25,30,50,70} formal semantic tokens. (2) Add component-tier token fallbacks where styles skip to semantic tier. (3) Split collapsed transition tokens (e.g., --hx-transition-fast) into --hx-duration-fast + --hx-easing-default. (4) Add hardcoded px/rem fallbacks to all hx-number-input primitive token references.
phase4_priorities.rationale: 30 components have token cascade violations. Missing overlay tokens are live production fallbacks that are hardcoded rgba() values. Violates no-hardcoded-values rule at scale.

phase4_priorities.task: Apply FormMixin to all form-associated HelixElement subclasses that lack it: hx-select, hx-switch, hx-slider, hx-textarea, hx-number-input, hx-radio-group, hx-date-picker, hx-time-picker. Remove duplicated validity delegation methods in hx-select. Export FormMixin from mixins/index.ts and main library barrel.
phase4_priorities.rationale: FormMixin is used by only 2 of 16 form-associated components. 14 components implement their own validity delegation, creating divergent dirty/touched/pristine tracking. hx-select has direct naming collision risk with FormMixin _updateValidity hook.

phase4_priorities.task: Apply FocusMixin to all interactive components with inner focusable elements: hx-select, hx-switch, hx-slider, hx-number-input, hx-textarea, hx-date-picker, hx-time-picker, hx-combobox, hx-checkbox.
phase4_priorities.rationale: FocusMixin is used by 1 of 9+ applicable components. Every other interactive component implements ad-hoc focus event management. Inconsistent focus handling creates subtle keyboard navigation regressions.

phase4_priorities.task: Type all hx-react event callbacks with specific CustomEvent<Detail> signatures rather than base Event. Remove read-only web component getters (validity, validationMessage, form, files) from settable React prop types. Add noImplicitReturns, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature to tsconfig.base.json.
phase4_priorities.rationale: 90+ React component event callbacks lose type safety by using base Event. React consumers cannot access event.detail without casting. 4 types expose read-only getters as settable props, implying consumer control that does not exist.

phase4_priorities.task: Fix hx-alert: (1) Convert imperative slotchange listeners in firstUpdated() to @slotchange template bindings. (2) Replace nested Promise.resolve().then() microtask chain with this.updateComplete.then() for announcer injection. (3) Migrate to extend HelixElement (covered by P1 but validate separately).
phase4_priorities.rationale: hx-alert has 3 independent Lit anti-patterns confirmed by both lit-specialist and senior-code-reviewer. Score 6.58 is dragged down by two HIGH-severity lit-patterns findings. Alert is a high-traffic accessibility-critical component.

phase4_priorities.task: Fix hx-toggle-button: replace console.warn with devWarn() utility. Fix hx-time-picker: replace private static _instanceCount with createIdCounter() module-scoped counter. Fix hx-select: remove empty connectedCallback override. Fix hx-radio-group: remove redundant role=radiogroup from fieldset element.
phase4_priorities.rationale: Small-effort targeted fixes for isolated anti-patterns. hx-time-picker ID counter breaks test isolation (resetIdCounter() not supported). hx-radio-group fieldset role override may confuse assistive technologies.

phase4_priorities.task: Add @deprecated JSDoc markers to all Wc* barrel re-exports in hx-library/src/index.ts. Remove the typo'd AriadDelegationMixinInterface alias from mixins/index.ts. Set removal target at 4.0.0 in CHANGELOG. Add a lint rule to block new Wc* or Ariad* exports.
phase4_priorities.rationale: 9+ deprecated Wc* type aliases have no @deprecated signal for consumers. The AriadDelegationMixinInterface typo is a public API defect. Small-effort cleanup that prevents accumulating permanent maintenance debt.
